en.muhajir-b-ali: 129. It has been reported that Abu 'Abd Allah (a.s) said:

Allah revealed to Musa ibn 'Imran: Amongst My servants, I decree Paradise for one who draws near to Me by a certain good deed. 'O Lord,' Musa (a.s) asked, 'what is this good deed?' 'This is bringing joy to a believer,' He replied.
